text:
Jun: Pasting compact variant mock — two quick things: the variant chip labels read identical to SR users and the mini-map scrubbing tooltip overlaps the chip when density is compact. figma.com/...

Ravi: Seen. For SR we should not rely on visual caps. Add an offscreen full label: "Variant B (id b12c) 1 25% traffic". That prevents ambiguity when screen readers iterate.

Claire: Tooltip overlap is annoying on small screens. Suggest pinning tooltip above the mini-map and add a small caret so it doesn't occlude chips. Also debounce show at 140ms to avoid flicker while scrubbing.

Mel: UX nit: paused variants look like disabled buttons. Make paused chips show a dashed border + small hover text "preview paused" (sr-only + visual). CSS idea: `.chip--paused { border: 1px dashed var(--muted); background: transparent; }`

a11y-bot: Scan: duplicate live regions found (chip aria-label + tooltip announcer). Recommendation: consolidate to one polite announcer (role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true") and update innerText only. Use aria-valuetext on slider for mini-map keyboard scrubbing: "v7.1.0, 25% traffic, fix: token cache".

Jun: Good. Action items: Ravi -> add sr-only variant id in Figma + microcopy; Claire -> implement tooltip pin + debounce; Mel -> paused-chip styles + samples; I'll add to QA checklist and mark as patch.
